title: Sonic Rumble Party
notes: Played over 30 matches, for about an hour, basically ran into no issues. **_IMPORTANT TO NOTE:_** on a previous version of Highball (I believe 0.5.3?) the controls wouldn't register until a couple attempts where I had to click outside the game window and then click back in the game window for the game to recognize the controls again. After updating I hadn't run into that issue so I believe this to now be perfectly playable as a result.
